  WHY: An item of about 490-500 characters passes plan-status, then fails at merge with `{"status":"full","reason":"section_item_too_long"}`, so handle_partial_delivery_merge() logs `reason=not_partial` and returns 1, and the issue is labelled ai:merged and closed with its deferred items silently lost.   WHY: The handler runs only once, on `pull_request.closed`. close_merged_issues_sweep in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (lines 5219-5224 and 5240-5243) only skips and never restarts, so the issue sits on a stale label (usually ai:ready-to-merge) and the only signal is a `::warning::`.
